content: Namo Guruve. Although "Calling the Guru from Afar" is widely renowned, the key point for invoking blessings is a devotion born of weariness and renunciation that is not merely lip service, but comes from the center of the heart, generated from the very depths of one's bones. With the certain conviction that there is no Buddha greater than the Guru, chant in a melodious tune:Guru, think of me!Kind Root Guru, think of me!Essence of the Buddhas of the three times,Source of the sacred Dharma of scripture and realization,Sovereign of the noble assembly of the Sangha,Root Guru, think of me!Great treasure of blessings and compassion,Source of the two kinds of accomplishments,Bestower of all desired enlightened activities,Root Guru, think of me!Guru Amitābha, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse of the simplicity of the Dharmakāya.For those of us with negative karma wandering in saṃsāra,Please lead us to the pure land of Great Bliss.Guru Avalokiteśvara, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse of the luminous Sambhogakāya.Pacify the sufferings of the six classes of beings from their very root,And empty the three realms of saṃsāra from their lowest depths.Guru Padmasambhava, think of me!Look upon me from the Lotus Light of Ngayab.For the wretched Tibetan people, helpless in this degenerate age,Please protect us swiftly with your compassion.Guru Yeshe Tsogyal, think of me!Look upon me from the celestial realm of Great Bliss.From the ocean of cyclic existence, deliver sinful beings like myselfTo the great city of liberation.Gurus of the Kama and Terma lineages, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse of primordial wisdom's unity.Having pierced the dark dungeon of my mind's confusion,Please cause the sun of realization to arise.Omniscient Drimé Özer, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse of the spontaneously present five lights.Having perfected the great power of the primordially pure realization,Please cause the four visions to reach their ultimate consummation.Peerless Lord Atisha and your spiritual sons, think of me!Look upon me from the midst of the hundred deities of Tuṣita.May you cause bodhicitta, the essence of emptiness and compassion,To be born within our mindstreams.Supreme siddhas Marpa, Mila, and Gampopa, think of me!Look upon me from the vajra expanse of great bliss.Having attained the supreme siddhi of Mahamudra, the union of bliss and emptiness,Please cause the Dharmakaya to awaken within the center of my heart.Karmapa, Lord of the World, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse where you tame beings throughout the reaches of space.Having realized that all phenomena are without true existence and like an illusion,Please cause appearances and mind to arise as the three kayas.Masters of the four major and eight minor Kagyü lineages, think of me!Look upon me from the realm of pure self-appearance.Having purified the delusions of the four states,Please cause my experience and realization to reach their ultimate perfection.Five venerable supreme masters, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse of the inseparability of samsara and nirvana.Through the integration of pure view, meditation, and conduct,Please cause me to traverse the supreme secret path.Peerless Shangpa Kagyü, think of me!Look upon me from the pure buddhafield.Having properly mastered the practices of means and liberation,Please cause me to attain the union of no-more-learning.Great Siddha Thangtong Gyalpo, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse of effortless compassion.Having perfected the yogic conduct of realizing the lack of true existence,Please cause my wind and mind to gain mastery and integrate.Sole father Dampa Sangye, think of me!Look upon me from the sphere of supreme accomplished activity.Having entered the blessings of the lineage into my heart,Please cause auspicious interdependence to arise impartially.Machig Labkyi Drönma, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse of the Perfection of Wisdom.Cut through the root of ego-clinging and arrogance,And grant that I may see the truth of selflessness, free from conceptual elaboration.Omniscient Dolpo Sangye, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse endowed with all supreme aspects.When the shifting breaths are arrested within the central channel,Please cause me to attain the vajra body, free from transition.Jetsun Taranatha, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse of the three messengers.Having traversed the secret vajra path without hindrance,Please cause me to accomplish the rainbow body of the celestial realms.Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse of the two types of primordial wisdom.Having dispelled the darkness of my ignorant mind,Please cause the light of supreme knowledge to flourish.Ösal Trülpé Dorjé, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse of five-colored rainbow light.Having purified the stains of the drops, winds, and mind,Please cause me to awaken in the youthful vase body.Pema Do-Ngak Lingpa, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse of unchanging bliss-emptiness.Please grant me the power to completely fulfillAll the intentions of the Victors and their heirs.Ngawang Yönten Gyatso, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse of the union of basic space and primordial wisdom.Having utterly shattered the grasping at the reality of appearances,Please grant me the power to take whatever arises as the path.Lodrö Taye, son of the victors, think of me!Look upon me from the state of love and compassion.Having recognized all beings as my kind parents,Please grant me the power to wholeheartedly accomplish the benefit of others.Pema Gargyi Wangchuk, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse of luminous great bliss.Having liberated the five poisons into the five wisdoms,Please grant me the power to destroy the dualistic grasping of rejection and attainment.Tennyi Yungdrung Lingpa, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse of the equality of existence and peace.Having given rise to genuine devotion within my being,Please grant me the power to make realization and liberation occur simultaneously.Drubse Karma Orgyen, think of me!Look upon me from the expanse of the primordial wisdom of luminosity and emptiness.By transferring the lineage to me, a fortunate child,Please grant me the power to seize the throne of realization.Kind root guru, think of me!Look upon me from your seat of great bliss at the crown of my head.Having beheld the true face of self-knowing dharmakaya,Please grant me the power to attain buddhahood in this single lifetime.Alas!Sentient beings like me, with such evil karma and sinful deeds,Have wandered through samsara for a long time since beginningless time.Because we will continue to experience endless suffering,And yet not even a single moment of renunciation has arisen within us,O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!And grant your blessings so that renunciation may arise from the depths of my heart.Although I have obtained the freedoms and advantages, I am one who wastes this life;I am constantly distracted by the meaningless activities of this life.Carried away by laziness in accomplishing the great purpose of liberation,I return empty-handed from the island of jewels.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that I may make this human life meaningful.Not a single person remains on this earth without dying;Even now, one after another, they depart for the next life.Although I too must die very soon,This rotten heart of mine still prepares to stay for a long time.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that I may realize there is no time and curtail my worldly ambitions.Beloved friends and relatives must all part ways;Wealth and possessions accumulated through stinginess will be enjoyed by others.Even this cherished body must be left behind,While the consciousness wanders aimlessly through the bardo and samsara.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that I may realize that nothing whatsoever is needed.Terrifying, pitch-black darkness greets me from the front,While the fierce red wind of karma drives me from behind.The hideous messengers of Yama beat and gore me;If I must experience such unbearable suffering in the lower realms,O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that I may be rescued from the abyss of the lower realms.My own faults, though as vast as mountains, I hide within;Others' faults, though as tiny as sesame seeds, I proclaim and deride.Though I lack even the slightest virtue, I am filled with pride;Bearing the name of a practitioner, I engage only in what is contrary to the Dharma.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that I may pacify self-interest and pride.I have harbored within the demon of ego-clinging, the cause of perpetual ruin;Every thought I have only serves to increase the afflictions,And every action I take bears the fruit of non-virtue.Since I have not turned even slightly toward the path of liberation,O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that ego-clinging may be severed at the root.At a mere word of praise or blame, pleasure and displeasure arise.At a mere harsh word, the armor of my patience falls away.Even when seeing the destitute, a compassionate mind does not arise.When an object of generosity appears, I am bound by the knot of stinginess.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that my mind-stream may merge with the Dharma.Though cyclic existence is without essence, I hold it to be essential.For the sake of food and clothing, I completely abandon my long-term goal.Although I have all necessities, my needs and desires only multiply.My own mind is deceived by these untrue, illusory phenomena.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that I may let go of the concerns of this life.Although I cannot endure even the slightest physical or mental suffering,I am so hard-hearted that I do not dread falling into the lower realms.Even as I clearly see that the laws of cause and effect are infallible,I fail to accomplish virtue and instead increase the turmoil of my negativity.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that conviction in the law of karma may arise.Hatred arises toward enemies and attachment toward kin.Regarding what to adopt and what to reject, I am as bewildered as if lost in the dark.When practicing the Dharma, I fall under the power of dullness, drowsiness, and sleep.Yet when engaged in non-Dharma activities, my senses are clear and alert.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings to vanquish the enemy of the mental afflictions.Outwardly, I have the appearance of a genuine practitioner,But inwardly, my own mind has not merged with the Dharma.Like a venomous snake, the afflictions are hidden within.When meeting with adverse conditions, the hidden flaws of this practitioner are revealed.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that I may tame my own mind-stream.Because I do not recognize my own base faults,I maintain the appearance of a practitioner while engaging in all manner of non-Dharma activities.I am powerfully habituated to the afflictions and non-virtuous actions.Though a virtuous mind is generated again and again, it repeatedly falters.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that I may see my own faults.As each day passes, I draw closer and closer to death.As each day is spent, my own mind becomes increasingly stubborn.Even as I rely on the guru, my devotion gradually declines.My affection and pure perception toward my spiritual brothers and sisters have grown ever smaller.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings to tame my wild and unruly mind-stream.Although I take refuge, arouse bodhicitta, and offer prayers,Because devotion and compassion are not born from the depths of my heart,My Dharma practices and virtuous activities have become mere words;I only go through the motions, and the practice does not take root in my being.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that whatever I do may turn into the Dharma.All suffering arises from the desire for my own happiness.Although it is taught that Buddhahood is achieved through the mind that benefits others,While generating the supreme resolve, I keep my selfish desires hidden deep within.Far from benefiting others, I incidentally bring them harm.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that I may be able to exchange myself for others.I perceive the Guru, who is the Buddha in person, as a mere human.I naturally forget his kindness in teaching me the profound instructions.When my own desires are not met, I cultivate despair.My mind is obscured by doubts and wrong views regarding his deeds and conduct.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that my devotion may increase without ever waning.Although my own mind is the Buddha, I have not recognized it.Although discursive thoughts are the Dharmakaya, I have not realized their true nature.Although it is the uncontrived and innate state, I have been unable to sustain it.Although it is the natural mode of abiding, I have not gained conviction in it.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that self-knowing awareness may be liberated in its own place.I am unable to remember from my heart that death is certain to come.I am unable to practice the sublime Dharma, which is certain to benefit, in accordance with the teachings.I do not properly adopt and abandon actions according to the certain truth of cause and effect.Failing to rely on the essential presence of mindfulness and alertness, I am carried away by distraction.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that I may be held by undistracted mindfulness.Due to past negative karma, I was born at the end of this degenerate age.Everything I have done in the past has become a cause for suffering.Evil companions have shrouded me in the stains of their negativity.Meaningless gossip has carried away my spiritual practice through distraction.O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that I may have the power of perseverance in the Dharma.In the beginning, I thought of nothing but the Dharma,Yet in the end, the result is the cause for samsara and the lower realms.The harvest of liberation has been destroyed by the frost of non-virtue.For wild and unruly beings like me, who ruin our long-term goals,O Guru, think of me! Look upon me quickly with your compassion!Grant your blessings so that I may bring the sacred Dharma to completion.Grant your blessings so that renunciation may arise from the depths of my heart.Grant your blessings so that I may realize there is no time and curtail my worldly ambitions.Grant your blessings so that I may remember death from the depths of my heart.Grant your blessings so that conviction in the law of karma may arise.Grant your blessings so that no obstacles may arise on the path.Grant your blessings so that I may have the power of diligence in practice.Grant your blessings so that adverse conditions may be taken onto the path.Grant your blessings so that the antidotes may hold their own ground.Grant your blessings so that uncontrived devotion may arise.Grant your blessings so that I may behold the true face of the natural state.Grant your blessings so that self-knowing awareness may awaken in the center of my heart.Grant your blessings so that the very root of delusive appearances may be severed.Grant your blessings so that I may attain buddhahood in a single lifetime.I supplicate you, precious Guru.I call out with longing, kind Lord of Dharma.For an unfortunate one like me, there is no place of hope but you.Grant your blessings so that my mind and your wisdom mind may merge inseparably.Although some devoted practitioners had previously requested this, it was delayed and left undone. Recently, at the earnest request of the noble Chödzema Samdrup Drönma and Deva Rakshita, I, Lodrö Taye, who holds the image of the Guru in this degenerate age, composed this at the great retreat center of Dzongshö Dechen Düpé. May virtue and excellence increase!
